text: In Schedule BP, at Sl.No. 5c "Dividend income" amount cannot be more than Zero.
In schedule BP, Sl.No. 19 should be equal to Sl.No. 17 of schedule Part A-OI

Exceptions: 1. If NOB has business code as 00001 and Schedule IF is filled. 2. If "Yes" is selected for "Are you liable for Audit u/s 92E?" in Schedule Part A General Information. 3. If "Yes" is selected for "Whether books of account of spouse is audited u/s 92E? or

Whether your spouse is a partner of a firm whose accounts are required to be audited u/s 92E under this Act?" in Schedule 5A 4. If 5cxvii or 6xvii or 7xvii of Schedule CFL is more than 0 5. If any field of Column 3 or Column 6 of Schedule UD is more than 0 In Schedule DPM, Sl.No. 6 should be equal to (3+4-5) Or enter zero if result is negative
In Schedule DPM, Sl.No. 9 in should be equal to (7-8) Or enter zero if result is negative
In Schedule DPM, Sl.No. 15 should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (10+11+12+13+14)
In Schedule DPM, Sl.No. 17 should be sum of Sl.No. (15-16)
In Schedule DPM, Written down value on the last day of previous year should be equal to Sl.No. 6+9-15 Or zero if the value is negative
If "New Tax Regime" is selected then in schedule DPM, Additional depreciation should not be more than zero
If "New Tax Regime" is selected then in schedule DPM, depreciation in 45% block cannot be claimed as per Rule 5.
Schedule DPM, Value of depreciation at Sl.No.10 is not matching as per the depreciation rates mentioned in Sl.No.2
Schedule DPM, Value of depreciation at Sl.No.11 is not matching as per the depreciation rates mentioned in Sl.No.2 at half rates
In Schedule DPM, value at sl.no.3 should match with 3a + 3b
In schedule DPM , amount at Sl. No. 3b cannot be greater than zero if assessee has selected Old tax regime for current assessment year in Part A General.
In schedule DPM, Proportionate depreciation at sl.no.18 should be out of Net aggregate depreciation at sl.no.17
In Schedule DOA, Amount on which depreciation at full rate to be allowed should be equal to Sl.No. 3 + 4 - 5 Or zero if the value is negative
In Schedule DOA, Sl.No. 9 should be equal to Sl.No. 7 - 8 or 0 if the value is negative
In Schedule DOA , Sl.No. 12 should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (10+11) 21
In Schedule DOA, Sl.No. 14 should be equal to Sl.No. 12-13
In Schedule DOA, Sl.No.17 should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (5+8-3-4-7-16)
In Schedule DOA, Sl.No. 18 should be equal to Sl.No. (6+9-12)
Schedule DOA, Value of depreciation at Sl.No.10 is not matching as per the depreciation rates mentioned in Sl.No.2
Schedule DOA, Value of depreciation at Sl.No.11 is not matching as per the depreciation rates mentioned in Sl.No.2 at half rates
In schedule DOA, Proportionate depreciation at sl.no.15 should be out of Net aggregate depreciation at sl.no.14
In Schedule DEP, Total depreciation on plant and machinery should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (1a + 1b + 1c+1d)
In Schedule DEP, total depreciation on building should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (2a + 2b + 2c)
In Schedule DEP, total depreciation should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (1e+2d+3+4+5)
In Schedule DEP, block of plant and machinery entitled for depreciation @ 15% should be equal to Sl.No. 17i or 18i, as applicable of Schedule DPM
In Schedule DEP, block of plant and machinery entitled for depreciation @ 30% should be equal to Sl.No. 17ii or 18ii, as applicable of schedule DPM
In Schedule DEP, block of plant and machinery entitled for depreciation @ 40% should be equal to Sl.No. 17iii or 18iii, as applicable of schedule DPM
In Schedule DEP, block of plant and machinery entitled for depreciation @ 45% should be equal to Sl.No. 17iv or 18iv, as applicable of schedule DPM
In Schedule DEP, block of Building entitled for depreciation @ 5% should be equal to Sl.No. 14ii or 15ii, as applicable of schedule DOA
In Schedule DEP, block of Building entitled for depreciation @ 10% should be equal to Sl.No. 14iii or 15iii, as applicable of schedule DOA
In Schedule DEP, block of Building entitled for depreciation @ 40% should be equal to Sl.No. 14iv or 15iv, as applicable of schedule DOA
In Schedule DEP block of furniture and fittings should be equal to Sl.No. 14v or 15v, as applicable of schedule DOA
In Schedule DEP block of intangible assets should be equal to Sl.No. 14vi or 15vi, as applicable of schedule DOA
In Schedule DEP block of ships should be equal to Sl.No. 14vii or 15vii, as applicable of schedule DOA
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 1e of should be equal to sum of (1a + 1b + 1c+ 1d)
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 2d should be equal to sum of (2a + 2b + 2c) 22
In Schedule DCG, "Total deemed capital gains on sale of depreciable assets" should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (1e+2d+3+4+5)
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 1a should be equal to Sl.No. 20i of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 1b should be equal to Sl.No. 20ii of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 1c should be equal to Sl.No. 20iii of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 1d should be equal to Sl.No. 20iv of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 2a should be equal to Sl.No. 17ii of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 2b should be equal to Sl.No. 17iii of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 2c should be equal to Sl.No. 17iv of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 3 should be equal to Sl.No. 17v of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 4 should be equal to Sl.No. 17vi of schedule DPM
In Schedule DCG, Sl.No. 5 should be equal to Sl.No. 17vii of schedule DPM
